web_bottleneck: HubSpot bottleneck: customers demand proof of value before buying and predictable AI credit costs; buying committees enlarged and more deals now need C-suite or board approval, adding weeks (2026-08-05 Q2 call). web_who_benefits_next: Solution partners and agencies: over 4,000 partners drive 25% of sourced ARR and help close about 50% of ARR (stockanalysis Analyst Day 2026-09-17). Frontier model vendors OpenAI, Anthropic, Google and Microsoft benefit via HubSpot connectors, extended by the 2026-09-16 OpenAI partnership; the ChatGPT Ads ecosystem and HubSpot Academy creators also gain.
web_who_loses: CRM and marketing incumbents and point solutions: Salesforce, Microsoft, Adobe, Zoho, Freshworks, Klaviyo and Mailchimp-class tools, plus SDR and agency labor whose outreach HubSpot agents automate (2026-08-05 Q2 call; 2026-09-17 Analyst Day via stockanalysis).

web_did_they_deliver: Partially. On 2026-08-05 HubSpot beat EPS (3.26 versus 3.02) and delivered 20% non-GAAP operating margin, up three points y/y, but missed net-add guidance at 7,000 versus 9,000-10,000 expected, and cut full-year NRR to roughly flat from 102% in Q2 (marketbeat; stockanalysis Q2 call). Margin promise kept, growth promise slipped.
web_what_would_falsify: 2026-11-04 Q3 2026 results: as-reported revenue growth below the guided 14% or net new customers below the guided 5,000-6,000 per quarter; full-year NRR falling below roughly flat; or net new ARR growth gap to revenue widening. Any of these falsifies the durable-growth-and-expanding-margin thesis (stockanalysis statistics and Q2 call).
